**Re-derived from the Q1 2026 primary this session.** Source: **Bank OZK Q1 2026 Management Comments**, table *"Classified and Criticized Assets"* (~p.22), furnished/filed with the Apr 21 2026 earnings release. On-disk primary: `raw/Q1_2026_mgmt_comments.pdf`. *(Citation note: **Bank OZK files with the FDIC, not SEC EDGAR** — no holding company since 2017; cert #110 — so there is no EDGAR accession; the primary is the FDIC securities filing, verified on disk. **Exact printed table, 3/31/26 column (the frozen line-set):**

|---|---|
| Special Mention (loans) | $397M |

**The $154M gap is RESOLVED — it is exactly the Foreclosed Assets line.** The 10-Q credit-quality risk-rating table is **loan-only** (Special Mention + Substandard on the loan book = ~$1,060.7M; 397+367+297 = 1,061 at Mgmt-Comments rounding). **FROZEN GRADING RULE for OZK-07 (classified leg):**
- **Canonical basis = the "Total Classified and Criticized Assets" line from Q2 Management Comments** (the same printed combined-total line that read $1,215M in Q1). Q2 prints its own combined total → **that printed line governs** (per Z2), no manual summing required.
- If (only if) Q2 omits the printed total line, reconstruct it from the identical 4-item set: Special Mention + Substandard Accrual + Substandard Non-accrual + Foreclosed Assets.
- **Q1 anchor = $1,215M** (includes foreclosed). **RISES** iff Q2 total **strictly > $1,215M** at printed $M precision (per Z9).
- **NEVER mix the 10-Q loan-only $1,060.7M basis** into this grade. If a grader has only the 10-Q, the like-for-like Q1 comparator is $1,060.7M (loan-only) — do not compare 10-Q-loan-only Q2 against Mgmt-Comments $1,215M Q1.
- **RESG leg (second half of OZK-07):** anchor = **RESG total commitments $27.8B at 3/31/26** (Mgmt Comments; down from $34.5B peak 3/31/24, −$6.7B). **FALLS** iff Q2 RESG total commitments strictly < $27.8B.

## Z1 — OZK-07 both-rise cell (adjudication rule attached)
OZK-07 TRUE **iff** classified+criticized **strictly UP** QoQ (Q2 total > $1,215M) **AND** RESG commitments **strictly DOWN** QoQ (< $27.8B). **Every other sign combination = FALSE.** The conviction step-down (→ step down from 🔴🔴) applies **only** to the both-falling sub-case (classified down AND RESG down = healthy de-risking, bull C7 gains). A **both-rise FALSE** logs *"classified still building, discriminator inconclusive — RESG runoff not yet confirmed"* **outside** the grade (does not step conviction down).

## Z3 — OZK-08 identifiability (no-names convention + Chapter contamination)
OZK never names borrowers, so a literal "IQHQ-specific reserve" reading is near-auto-FALSE and must not be. **OZK-08 fires iff a disclosed credit-level specific reserve matches ≥2 of these frozen RaDD anchors:** {San Diego · life-science R&D district · Aug-2026 maturity · ~$555M funded · largest life-sci/RESG credit}. **Naming is NOT required.** A generic or single-anchor "life-science reserve" does **NOT** fire. **Seattle / Chapter / U-District identifiers affirmatively EXCLUDE** — the Chapter (Seattle U-Dist) reserve is the *more likely* Q2 life-sci headline and must not contaminate OZK-08 (see Z5). FALSE stamps only **after the full Wed 7/22 8:30a call** (Z8); a 10-Q-only disclosure (~Aug) never flips OZK-08 — it logs as OZK-09 color.

## Z4 / Z6 / Z9 — threshold-edge & precision conventions
- **Z4 (OZK-06):** exactly-$550M and exactly-2.00% = **not exceeded = FALSE**. "Past-due loans" = the Supplement line that reproduces Q1's $465M/1.41% (verify by reproducing Q1 first).

- **Z9 (OZK-07 precision):** rises/falls = strict inequality at finest printed precision; a tie at printed precision = flat = **FALSE**.

## Z7 — OZK-01 Tuesday proxy + H1 method
TRUE iff H1 CRE charge-offs >5% annualized, else FALSE (the 2–5% dead band collapses into FALSE at resolution). **Tuesday proxy:** H1 total-loan annualized NCO **≤2.5% → FALSE immediately** (CRE ≥~50% of loans caps the CRE rate below 5%); else hold for the ~Aug Call Report CRE-specific figure. **H1 method:** 2×(Q1+Q2 NCO$) ÷ H1 avg loans.

## Z8 / Z10 — resolution-window timing
- **Z8:** OZK-08 resolution window = release + Supplement + Mgmt Comments + **the full 7/22 call**; FALSE stamps only after the call.
- **Z10:** OZK-09 resolves early **only** on an **executed-and-disclosed** August resolution at the print; intent language ("we expect to extend") never resolves it.
